The user asks to search the web with a web search tool. I have web_fetch but not a web search tool. The instruction says "If you have no web search tool, reply exactly NO-SEARCH-TOOL. Do not try any other way."

So I should reply exactly NO-SEARCH-TOOL. I must not use web_fetch as a substitute.

But wait—is web_fetch a web search tool? No, it's a fetch tool for a specific URL, not a search tool. The instruction says not to try any other way. So answer NO-SEARCH-TOOL.
